DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (Oligoarticular)

The normal CRP with only a slightly elevated ESR and the chronic, sleep-disrupting nature of the pain without signs of acute infection or trauma makes a bacterial infection or septic arthritis highly unlikely. The specific pattern of night pain and swelling in a young male without trauma is classic for an inflammatory arthritis like JIA.
